guide.text: A cuff that locks when you touch it. It opens by itself after 5 seconds.
State: a mode of the script. This one has default and locked.
Timer: wakes the script every second, here to count down.
Press Watch folder. Pick examples, then objects, then Timed_lock.
Press Show effects in 3D view, so it shows a tick.
Open Send input, low on Live scripts, and press Touch.
The ring at the left wrist turns red.
The log counts down: 4 seconds left, 3 seconds left.
After 5 seconds the ring turns green again.
Change SECONDS = 5 to SECONDS = 10 and save. Touch it again.
